revealed_boundary_note: the layer's stated floor is 0.72 but its revealed operating point is about 0.90: re-deriving this agent's comparator on the 3,049 near parallels it accepted gives median 0.9767, p05 0.9026, p25 0.9540. A discovered pair is graded against what the layer actually kept, not against what it says it keeps.
floor_justification: retained from the existing layer only because it clears this agent's own measured ceiling: the worst of 120,000 mispaired cross-Veda draws is 0.5225, so 0.72 sits 0.1975 above the highest score any unrelated pair reached
comparator: difflib.SequenceMatcher character LCS ratio over the sandhi-insensitive surface, autojunk=False
search_derivative_refused: the AV SEARCH_DERIVATIVE layer deletes base letters and is never read here
fold_correction: anusvara-arrival-forms-and-run-collapse-v1. enrich/surfaces.build_surfaces transliterates to Latin BEFORE it folds, so every Devanagari rule in normalize/unicode.TRANSCRIPTION_EQUIVALENCES is dead on the script_folded surface -- the only surface a cross-script pair can be compared on. Proof: fold_transcription of the Vajasaneyi cluster is one sentinel, and fold_transcription(to_iast(same)) is two. Two symptoms: U+1CEA + U+0902 folded to two sentinels (780 YV verses), and U+0901 candrabindu transliterated to an unfoldable ASCII tilde (138 YV, 3 SV). Corrected here by adding the post-transliteration arrival forms and collapsing a run of the anusvara sentinel to one. The exact patch to normalize/unicode.py is staged at proofs/surfaces_fold_patch.txt: that module is NOT this agent's write surface.
fold_correction_not_applied_to: the lateral series and the homorganic nasals, both measured and both genuine differences between the editions rather than fold gaps; and numerals, which never survive past punctuation_normalized.
